GSAP 3.15.0 and ScrollTrigger 3.15.0
Production distributions (line endings and trailing whitespace normalized; code unchanged) from the official npm package:
https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap/v/3.15.0
https://registry.npmjs.org/gsap/-/gsap-3.15.0.tgz

Copyright and license notices are retained in each script header.
GSAP uses its Standard License, distinct from on-air's MIT license:
https://gsap.com/standard-license/
Official source: https://github.com/greensock/GSAP

Files are self-hosted; the website makes no animation CDN requests.
